name: Sydney civil engineer wanting metropolitan projects

constraints: No FIFO or long remote rotations
Wants realistic site location and travel requirements
context.company_awareness: Has contractor shortlist; less aware of utility, consultancy and council alternatives.

trigger: A proposed regional project rotation makes the engineer look for work that allows regular nights at home.

searches_run.observation: Retrieved SEEK, Indeed and a Sydney Water vacancy. The Sydney Water page failed to load; the inspected SEEK page showed diverse contractor, council and consultancy roles.

searches_run.query: civil engineer Sydney jobs no FIFO Monday Friday infrastructure
searches_run.observation: Results still included FIFO/DIDO roles. Direct SEEK inspection placed a DIDO roster and projects up to four hours away under Sydney, illustrating that search location may be a hiring base rather than daily worksite.

sources.title: Civil Engineer Jobs in Sydney | SEEK
sources.supports: Directly inspected listing page includes local infrastructure roles and Sydney-labelled FIFO/DIDO rosters; supports a location-semantics concern only.

sources.title: Civil Engineer | Sydney Water
sources.supports: Retrieved employer listing concerns infrastructure assets; direct fetch failed, so vacancy and details remain unverified.

proof_needed: Source evidence separating office base from worksite

conversion_objections: Sydney location does not mean Sydney worksite.
Metro projects can still require night or weekend work.
Are the contractors I know covered?
SEEK already has many openings and alerts.

avoid_targeting.reason: Hours cannot be inferred from metro location or missing roster text.

message_to_founder: Simulation: I know roughly who I want to work for, but Sydney-labelled results still send me away for weeks. Show where the actual project is and what the posting says about rotations; a city filter alone does not solve my problem.

confidence_and_limits: Synthetic simulation, not an interview or an independent respondent. Two queries retrieved on 2026-09-28, with at least one direct page inspection. Queries without observed source IDs are hypotheses. Combined retrieval is not a controlled ranking report. No volume, difficulty or conversion inference. Source claims and role availability can change; product fit uses the supplied repository brief.
